notes: Solid blue links are menu navigation. Green links are data flow. Dashed amber links describe context or configuration; they are not extra processing stages.
The workflow view is a reviewed conceptual map, not an execution trace. Preparing images and formatting tables are parallel ways to reach a triplet.
Recipes supply saved answers to the same registered actions. Registry presence does not by itself mean an action appears directly in the visible Home menu.

Repeat context selects groups using a repeat column and key strings. Visualization repeats the collected commands within each group and selected category (catlist). Some plot-specific category limits apply.
Script inventory includes files not directly linked to a mapped entry point. These are not classified as unused or unreachable.
Reviewed relationships are editable in annotations.json; generated declarations come from build_map.py. View layout is independent from the truth map.

nodes.label: Image data
nodes.description: CZI / SVS / TIFF, depending on registration path.

nodes.label: Raw CSV tables
nodes.description: Paths, folders or recursive globs; assemble and select coordinates/observations.

nodes.label: Segmentation masks
nodes.description: Object-label images; label identity must match downstream cells.

nodes.label: Triplet: df + obs + dfxy
nodes.description: Aligned cell features, annotations and coordinates. Shared cell index.

nodes.label: HTML spatial viewer
nodes.description: Image/segmentation assets, ROIs, marker thresholds and cell annotations.

nodes.label: Recipe: saved action choices
nodes.description: Ordered {do, with, steps} rows. Collected choices and explicit answers reuse registered controller/analysis/visualization actions.

nodes.label: Repeat context: column + filters
nodes.description: Select groups (e.g. slide_scene or patient) and run the chosen commands per group.

nodes.label: Categories / catlist
nodes.description: Selected obs columns for plotting. Inside each repeat group, visualization runs commands for each eligible category.

nodes.label: Collected command list
nodes.description: Choose operations/options once, then execute repeatedly. This is separate from data subsetting.
